operation.raw_value: Microwave irradiation with stirring; progress monitored by TLC

original_text.raw_value: General Procedure B. A solution of the appropriate allene derivative (0.16 mmol) in dry toluene (6.0 mL) was irradiated in a microwave reactor at 150 °C for 3–7.5 h with stirring while monitored by TLC; solvent was evaporated in vacuo and products 8a–e were crystallized from Et2O.
original_text.normalized_value: General Procedure B. A solution of the appropriate allene derivative (0.16 mmol) in dry toluene (6.0 mL) was irradiated in a microwave reactor at 150 °C for 3–7.5 h with stirring while monitored by TLC; solvent was evaporated in vacuo and products 8a–e were crystallized from Et2O.

addition_order.raw_value: A solution of the appropriate substrate in dry toluene was placed in the microwave reactor.
